input_real_person.body: {{item}} appears to show a real person, which this model doesn’t accept. Use one without a recognisable person.

input_media_bad_shape.body: {{item}} is too wide or too tall. Use a shape between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1.

input_video_too_long.bodyMax: This model takes up to {{max}} seconds of video in total. Trim the clips or attach fewer.

input_upscale_source_too_large.title: Nothing to upscale

input_media_flagged.title: File not accepted
input_media_flagged.body: {{item}} was flagged by the model’s content filter. Try a different file.

input_prompt_too_long.bodyMax: Keep the prompt under {{max}} characters for this model.
input_prompt_too_long.body: Your prompt is too long for this model.

video_task_mismatch.title: Wrong input mode
video_task_mismatch.body: This prompt edits or continues your video, which References mode can’t do. Try Edit video or Extend video.

output_copyright.title: Blocked for copyright
output_copyright.bodyAudio: The generated sound resembled copyrighted music. Try again with sound off, or ask for original sound effects instead of a song.
output_copyright.body: The result resembled copyrighted material. Change the prompt or the references and try again.

output_flagged.title: Blocked by safety filter
output_flagged.body: The result was blocked by the model’s safety filter. Adjust the prompt or the references and try again.

output_empty.title: No result
output_empty.body: The model returned nothing this time. Try again or reword the prompt.

provider_busy.title: Model busy
provider_busy.body: The model is overloaded right now. Try again in a few minutes.

provider_timeout.title: Timed out
provider_timeout.body: The model took too long to respond. Try again.

system.title: Something went wrong
system.body: This one is on us. Try again — if it keeps happening, contact support.
